sanskrit: dyāvāpṛthivī saṃ nahyethāṃ mama rāṣṭrāya jayantī amitrebhyo hetim asyantī ||
english: Let Dyāvāpṛthivī — Heaven-and-Earth — bind themselves together, conquering for my kingdom, hurling the missile against enemies.

sanskrit: vātā pavamānau saṃ nahyethāṃ mama rāṣṭrāya jayantāv amitrebhyo hetim asyantau ||
english: Let the two Winds, the Purifying Breezes, bind themselves together, conquering for my kingdom, hurling the missile against enemies.

sanskrit: indrāgnī saṃ nahyethāṃ (…) ||
english: Let Indrāgnī — Indra-and-Agni — bind themselves together, conquering for my kingdom, hurling the missile against enemies.

sanskrit: mitrāvaruṇā saṃ (…) (…) ||
english: Let Mitrāvaruṇā — Mitra-and-Varuṇa — bind themselves together, conquering for my kingdom, hurling the missile against enemies.

english: Let the two Aśvins bind themselves together, conquering for my kingdom, hurling the missile against enemies.

sanskrit: marutaḥ saṃ nahyadhvaṃ mama rāṣṭrāya jayanto 'mitrebhyo hetim asyantaḥ ||
english: Let the Maruts bind themselves together, conquering for my kingdom, hurling the missile against enemies.

english: Let the Pitṛs — the Ancestral Fathers — bind themselves together, conquering for my kingdom, hurling the missile against enemies.

english: Let Sūrya-and-Candramās — Sun and Moon — bind themselves together, conquering for my kingdom, hurling the missile against enemies.

english: Let Day-and-Night bind themselves together, conquering for my kingdom, hurling the missile against enemies.

english: Let the Gandharvas and Apsarasas bind themselves together, conquering for my kingdom, hurling the missile against enemies.

sanskrit: sarpapuṇyajanāḥ saṃ (…) ||
english: Let the Serpents and the Puṇyajanas bind themselves together, conquering for my kingdom, hurling the missile against enemies.

sanskrit: vanaspatayaḥ saṃ (…) ||
english: Let the Forest-Trees (Vanaspatayaḥ) bind themselves together, conquering for my kingdom, hurling the missile against enemies.

english: Let the offspring of forest-trees (Vānaspatyāḥ) bind themselves together, conquering for my kingdom, hurling the missile against enemies.

english: Let the creeping herbs (Vīrudhaḥ) bind themselves together, conquering for my kingdom, hurling the missile against enemies.

sanskrit: bṛhaspate saṃ nahyasva mama rāṣṭrāya jayann amitrebhyo hetim asyan ||
english: O Bṛhaspati, bind yourself together, conquering for my kingdom, hurling the missile against enemies.

sanskrit: parameṣṭhin saṃ nahyasva mama rāṣṭrāya jayann amitrebhyo hetim asyan ||
english: O Parameṣṭhin, bind yourself together, conquering for my kingdom, hurling the missile against enemies.

sanskrit: udārā ud īrdhvaṃ viśvāni bhūtāni saṃ nahyadhvaṃ mama rāṣṭrāya jayanty amitrebhyo hetim asyanti ||
english: Rise up, ye exalted ones; let all beings bind themselves together, conquering for my kingdom, hurling the missile against enemies.

sanskrit: agnī rakṣitā sa imāṃ senāṃ rakṣatu | anuṣṭhātar anu tiṣṭha sarve vīrā bhavantu me ||
english: Agni is the guardian; may he protect this army. O executor, stand by; may all heroes be mine.
